args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to all production regions) began failing health checks with error rate ~18% across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

Actions taken:
- Reviewed release history; v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and marked unhealthy. Most recent production-healthy release was v2.3.0.
- Initiated rollback to v2.3.0 in all production regions. First attempt halted partway with an orchestrator error after us-east (resulting in a mixed state: us-east on v2.3.0; us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1).
- Retried the rollback; it completed successfully across all three regions.

Current state: all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate ~0.2%.

Note: v2.3.1-rc in staging also shows unhealthy — likely related and worth investigating before re-attempting a production rollout. No change-manager approval was required since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was in fact created despite the timeout response, so no retry was needed (the idempotency key would have protected against a duplicate anyway).

## Summary

**Rollback: complete and verified healthy**

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api was on `v2.3.1` in all three production regions, unhealthy, with an 18% error rate.
- **Target selection:** From the release history, `v2.3.0` (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production. Note `v2.3.1-rc` (seq 2) also exists but is a *staging* release and unhealthy, so it was correctly excluded.
- **First rollback attempt:** Failed partway with an orchestrator error. This left a **mixed state** — us-east on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west remained on the unhealthy v2.3.1 (service still unhealthy, 18% error rate). This is worth flagging: the tool reported an error but had applied a real partial change.
- **Retry:** Succeeded — all of us-east, us-west, and eu-west are now on v2.3.0.
- **Verification:** `get_service_status` confirms healthy: true, error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident: INC-0001 opened (SEV2)**

- Title: "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"
- Summary documents the symptom, the rollback, the partial-failure/retry sequence, and the current verified state.

**Approval policy:** No change-manager approval was required, since the policy only gates deploying a version that has *never* been healthy in production. `v2.3.0` was previously healthy in production.

**Follow-up worth noting:** `v2.3.1-rc` is also unhealthy in staging. That's probably the same root cause and should be investigated before anyone attempts another `v2.3.1` rollout — I've called this out in the incident summary.
